name: Grey drizzle
story: A soft, grey, dripping day of the kind the coast is famous for: a low ceiling of stratus, fine drizzle on and off, the hilltops in the cloud and the water flat and dark. Flyable along the coast with care; the high strips are in cloud.
forecast: Overcast, base 350-450 m, the hills in cloud. Light drizzle at times, visibility 8-10 km, 5 km in drizzle. Southeast 6-8 kt. Overcast night.
